page.title: Today
page.purpose: Answer 'what am I eating next, and what do I do?' with a meal-first hero that starts cooking in one action, a quick swap, the week at a glance, and the rest of the day's food and supplements with explicit scope.

priorities.statement: The next relevant meal — its local date and slot, title, times, and Start cooking — leads the page in every media treatment.
Swap meal is one action away and changes only the selected future occurrence, previewing material effects before applying.
The hero keeps the same regions and actions whether it shows an approved scene, an ordinary photo, or no image at all.
The week strip gives one-tap access to the other planned days without leaving Today.
Ready for tonight points straight at the ingredient check and the grocery list.
The Today overview shows the rest of the day's meals, recurring items, and supplements with Planned, Recorded, or Expected scope named, so one meal never reads as the whole day.
An empty or unconfigured account invites Choose a meal or Plan my week instead of showing demo food.

states.description: The selected occurrence renders as an immersive scene hero because an approved matching scene exists for the current appearance and viewport.
First read of the page's data; stable skeletons reserve the layout so nothing shifts on arrival, and no sample food is shown as saved data.
Some contributing data is unknown or could not be read; what is missing is named rather than shown as zero.
Displayed data is older than its freshness window; its age is shown next to it.
A write is in flight; the affected control shows a busy state and says why it is unavailable, and success appears only after the durable save.
The request failed; the reason and the next action are stated, pending edits are kept, and nothing is edited against a fake empty account.
The client cannot reach the API; cached data, locally pending actions, and server-confirmed saves are distinguished and unsupported actions say why.
The workspace is configured but nothing is planned; the hero is replaced by an invitation to Choose a meal or Plan my week, never the demo bowl.
A fresh account with no setup; the page explains configuration, allows exploration, and makes no personal claims.
Only an ordinary photo exists for the meal; the editorial treatment frames the photo beside the text with the same actions.
No reliable image exists; the minimal treatment uses typography and an ingredient summary and still reads as intentional.
The hero image fails after load; the region falls back to the next treatment without moving the title or actions or showing a broken image.
The person picked a meal on another date; the eyebrow names that day and slot, never Tonight.
The selected meal is ready to eat; the primary action is View meal or Log meal and no cooking steps are invented.
The selected meal is a draft without instructions; the primary action is Edit, not an empty cooking screen.
No recipe satisfies the active required rules for the slot; the blocking conditions are named with Add a meal and Review restrictions, and no rule is relaxed.
The swap dialog lists suitable alternatives immediately; optional reason chips rerank them.
The chosen alternative has material effects (a leftover dependency, a lock, a required target, or groceries); an impact preview must be accepted before applying.
The selected occurrence is already recorded as eaten; the next slot is offered and history is not editable.

elements.name: Primary
elements.description: The five destinations Today, Week, Meals, Groceries, Kitchen in that order: header links on desktop, labelled bottom tabs on phones.

elements.name: Next meal
elements.description: The selected occurrence's hero: media, eyebrow, title, description, times, and actions.
The scene or editorial image; decorative scene art is hidden from assistive technology while a meal photo has a short description. Absent in the minimal treatment.
The local date and slot, such as TODAY · WEDNESDAY or Tuesday's dinner.
The meal's name in the editorial serif; long names wrap instead of shrinking.
One short line describing the meal.

elements.name: Time
elements.description: Active preparation time and total elapsed time, each with its own unknown state; an unknown time reads Time not set.

elements.name: Start cooking
elements.description: Starts or resumes a cooking session for the selected revision, method, and servings.

elements.name: Swap meal
elements.description: Opens suitable alternatives for the selected future occurrence.

elements.name: More meal actions
elements.description: Opens View recipe, Move, Lock or unlock, Change servings, Skip, Remove from plan, and Record intake as the occurrence allows.

elements.name: Your week
elements.description: Seven days with each planned meal's thumbnail and name; the selected day is marked by more than colour.

elements.name: Week
elements.description: Previous and next week controls with the local date range.

elements.name: Ready for tonight
elements.description: Links to check ingredients and open the grocery list for the selected slot.

elements.name: Check ingredients
elements.description: Opens the ingredient check for the selected meal.

elements.name: Open grocery list
elements.description: Opens Groceries scoped to the current plan.

elements.name: Today overview
elements.description: The rest of the day: meals by slot, recurring items, and supplement occurrences; collapsible.

elements.name: Scope
elements.description: Planned, Recorded, or Expected scope for the overview's nutrition summary.

elements.name: Plan today
elements.description: Choose a meal and Plan my week for an empty plan.
Explains that suggestions do not reflect rules that have not been entered yet.

elements.name: What sounds better?
elements.description: Suitable alternatives with optional reason chips.
Eligible alternatives, each with name, active time, and a short reason.

elements.name: Reasons
elements.description: Something different, Less effort, Lower cost, Missing ingredients; none is required.

elements.name: Swap impact
elements.description: Material effects of a swap on leftovers, locks, targets, and groceries, with Apply and Keep current.
The rules blocking every candidate, with Add a meal and Review restrictions.
States that the occurrence is already recorded and points at the next slot.

claims.statement: Start cooking is the one visually dominant action; Swap meal and the occurrence menu are subordinate.
On phones the meal title and Start cooking are visible without scrolling; decorative artwork shrinks or disappears before the action does.
Scene, editorial, and minimal treatments present the same eyebrow, title, times, and actions in the same order.
When the image fails, the hero falls back to the next treatment without a broken-image icon or moving the actions.
Light and Evening change palette and artwork only; the recipe, servings, dates, occurrences, layout, and actions are identical.
An empty or unconfigured account shows Choose a meal or Plan my week and never the demo meal.
Before setup, the page says suggestions do not yet reflect unentered rules.
A meal on another date is labelled with its day and slot and never as Tonight.
A ready-to-eat meal offers View meal or Log meal instead of Start cooking.
An unknown duration reads Time not set and is perceivably different from a known 0 min.
The overview names Planned, Recorded, or Expected scope, and one meal's protein never appears as the day's total.
Swap changes only the selected future occurrence and shows an impact preview before applying a material change.
When nothing fits the required rules, the blockers are named and no restriction is loosened to produce a meal.
An eaten occurrence is reported as recorded and the next slot is offered instead of a replacement.
Start cooking, Swap meal, the occurrence menu, every week-strip day, and the swap dialog are keyboard reachable, and the dialog returns focus to its trigger.
On phones the primary navigation is five labelled bottom tabs — Today, Week, Meals, Groceries, Kitchen — above the safe area, and it never covers content.
With reduced motion, media and state changes are instant or brief opacity changes with no slide, bounce, or parallax.
The page never scrolls sideways at any supported viewport, including 320 px and 200 % zoom.
